patterns.mechanism: A cover carries one dominant hook so a cold reader can decide during the feed pause.
patterns.application: Keep the cover headline short, put the mechanism in the subtitle, and use one authentic UI strip instead of a feature inventory.

patterns.mechanism: Recognition grows when the opening describes a task the reader already performs, then removes it.
patterns.application: Open with finishing a document but rebuilding slides; say that Markdown can now present directly.

patterns.mechanism: Software posts earn trust when the second image answers what does it look like.
patterns.application: Card two must be the full ReadMD interface with minimal overlay.

patterns.mechanism: One core mechanism prevents a release list from diluting recall.
patterns.application: Let presentation mode lead; compress other updates into supporting workflow sentences.

patterns.mechanism: Concrete outcomes transfer better than quality adjectives.
patterns.application: Describe theme switching, font sizing, protected code/table slicing, and direct presenting rather than calling the UI premium.

patterns.mechanism: A niche tool becomes shareable when tied to a recognizable human task.
patterns.application: Name course notes, group-meeting reports, technical talks, and paper presentations.

patterns.mechanism: Practical structure increases saves because readers can reuse the decision rule.
patterns.application: Give each feature card one title, one benefit sentence, and one authentic UI region.

patterns.mechanism: A scoped comment prompt produces usable feedback better than a broad call for support.
patterns.application: Ask which Markdown file the reader would present first.

patterns.mechanism: Repeated canvas, margins, palette, type, and component style create recognition across swipe.
patterns.application: All cards read from one token file and lock 1080x1440, cool paper surface, ink text, and signal-red accent.

patterns.mechanism: Social carousels fail when pages look like bullet-slide screenshots.
patterns.application: Use magazine-like headers, generous whitespace, real UI regions, and one job per card.

forbidden: blue-purple gradient as the default technology style
bullet-point slide screenshots as social cards
generic words like revolutionary, seamless, next-gen
fabricated user counts, downloads, revenue, or testimonials
release asset filenames presented as user-facing fixes
